## ChatOSS v0.8.2

### Fixes
- **BYOK/API-key vision capability** — API-key (userkey::) models reported no capabilities, so vision was gated off and images were never sent even though they're already encoded as OpenAI image_url parts. modelSupportsCapability now assumes a modern provider model thinks / calls tools / sees images, and the model picker shows thinking/tools/vision badges on BYOK rows.
- **Branch/worktree footer UX** — the worktree chip was nested inside the branch <button>, so both chips opened the same branch popover and the worktree name read like a second branch. The branch is now a clearly-clickable accent pill; the worktree is a separate, read-only indicator. Toggle clarified to Use worktree / Leave worktree.
- Includes the 0.8.1 fix: edit-and-resend rollback + editor now route through the active chat's worktree (not the main checkout).
